title: Dirty check ignores registry/runs.tsv only if it is not the first changed file
affects: start of convert/morphometry (refuses to run; no data affected)
details: git status --porcelain output was stripped; the leading space of the first status code was lost and the path was cut wrong.

title: Morphometry fails on a ROI without cells (empty CellInstances table read as text)
affects: build_morphometric_results: ROI with 0 detections gets no feature row (error), its group is missing from the weighted table
details: pmc J0045: B9_x3421_x124_x4a_r_trace_2 (H5 num_detections=0, include_row=1) -> weighted 819 instead of 820 rows. Also: convert marks a 0-cell H5 as ok; should be flagged.

title: Morphometry cannot find special-trace masks (<roi>_special_trace_mask.tif)
affects: build_morphometric_results: ROI with special_trace=1 gets no feature row (error "Unable to find file ..._mask.tif"); its group is missing from the weighted table (only_texture)
details: vsp 20261106_1133_morphometry: 6 of 500 ROIs (trace_type onlyouter1, special_trace=1, include_row=1) -> weighted 404 instead of 410 groups. JBA_TA names these masks <roi>_special_trace_mask.tif; one() in build_morphometric_results.m only tries <roi>_mask.tif. convert records only mask_dir, not the mask file used per ROI.
